Before you begin

Momo is a Windows 11 x64 desktop application. The standard portable package includes its .NET runtime. Extract the complete folder, then run MomoMonitor.exe. Protected hardware readings need administrator access and the supported sensor driver.

This guide uses the English interface in version 0.1.6. Set Settings → General → Language → English, then press OK. Screenshots come from the actual WPF application; readings and available controls vary by computer. Alert examples are explicitly identified.

Read the label beside the watts. A power figure may cover components, CPU + GPU, battery discharge or estimated wall input. Those scopes answer different questions. See Power, energy & cost.
